title: Errors and result types map
intro: This module teaches how TypeScript handles failures on top of JavaScript's untyped throw. You will learn why catch uses unknown, how Result and Either patterns model expected errors, when to subclass Error versus use discriminated unions, how assertion functions and never enable exhaustive handling, and how these patterns compare to C# exceptions and TryParse.

overviewDiagram.title: TypeScript error handling flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  START[Function runs] --> EXPECTED{Expected failure?}
  EXPECTED -->|yes| RESULT[Return Result ok false error]
  EXPECTED -->|no| RISKY[Risky work try]
  RISKY -->|success| OK[Return value or Result ok true]
  RISKY -->|throw| CATCH[catch e unknown]
  CATCH --> NARROW[instanceof / toError / assertIsError]
  NARROW --> MAP[Map to AppError or HttpError]
  MAP --> HANDLE[Log retry HTTP status or rethrow]
  RESULT --> HANDLE

conceptCards.title: catch with unknown
conceptCards.summary: Strict TypeScript types catch as unknown because anything can be thrown. Narrow with instanceof Error or toError before reading .message.

conceptCards.title: Result and Either
conceptCards.summary: Discriminated union { ok: true, value } | { ok: false, error } makes failures visible in the signature. Use for validation, parse, and not-found on hot paths.

conceptCards.title: Custom errors and unions
conceptCards.summary: Subclass Error for middleware and stack traces. Use kind-tagged unions inside Result for business errors. cause chains inner failures like C# InnerException.
conceptCards.example: class HttpError extends Error { statusCode: number }

conceptCards.title: Assertions and never
conceptCards.summary: asserts x is T narrows after the call. never in switch default forces compile errors when error unions grow.

conceptCards.title: Versus C# exceptions
conceptCards.summary: C# has typed catch and when filters. TypeScript has unknown and instanceof. Both prefer Result/TryParse for expected failures.
conceptCards.example: C# catch when 429 ↔ TS catch unknown + isRateLimited(err)
